gen.title: Relation between specific heats and gas constant

variables.name: cp
variables.quote: We have added a subscript “p” to the specific heat capacity to remind us that this value only applies to a constant pressure process.

variables.name: cv
variables.quote: We have added a subscript “v” to the specific heat capacity to remind us that this value only applies to a constant volume process.

variables.name: r
variables.quote: The equation of state of a gas relates the temperature, pressure, and volume through a gas constant R.
